name: Apple
definition: fresh or frozen apple, eaten or cooked, sold as the fruit.

name: Asian pear [nashi]
definition: fresh round, crisp-fleshed Asian pear, a different fruit from the European pear.

name: Cherry
definition: fresh or frozen cherry, filed with stone fruit.

name: Clementine
definition: small seedless, easy-peel mandarin type sold as clementine.

name: Satsuma [mikan]
definition: loose-skinned, seedless mandarin type sold as satsuma or mikan.

name: Pomelo
definition: fresh pomelo (pummelo), the large thick-skinned citrus.

name: Mixed berries
definition: final kind of the leaf: a mix of berries or small fruit in which no one kind is half or more of the weight, such as a forest-fruit mix.

name: Grape
definition: fresh table grape, sold to eat.

name: Melon
definition: fresh melon other than watermelon, sold whole or cut.

name: Watermelon
definition: fresh watermelon, sold whole or cut.

name: Plantain
definition: starchy cooking banana, green or ripe, filed with tropical fruit; the cooking use is an attribute.

name: Mixed fruit
definition: final kind of the sub-family: a mix of fruit from several crop groups in which no one kind is half or more of the weight, such as a smoothie mix.

name: Lettuce
definition: fresh lettuce, whole or as cut leaves.

name: Spinach
definition: fresh or frozen spinach, leaf or bunched.

name: Rocket
definition: fresh rocket (arugula) leaves, filed with leaf vegetables, not herbs.

name: Mixed salad leaves
definition: final kind of the leaf: an undressed mix of salad leaves in which no one leaf is half or more of the weight.

name: Cabbage
definition: fresh cabbage of any head type.

name: Spring onion [scallion, green onion, salad onion]
definition: fresh young onion eaten with its green stems.

name: Sweet pepper [capsicum, bell pepper]
definition: fresh sweet, non-pungent pepper; measured heat is not part of this kind.

name: Chilli [hot pepper]
definition: fresh or frozen pungent pepper; heat is a measured attribute.

name: Avocado
definition: fresh avocado, filed with vegetables because it is not sweet as sold.

name: Courgette [zucchini]
definition: fresh courgette, with squash of the same culinary use.

name: Sweetcorn [corn]
definition: fresh or frozen sweetcorn, on the cob or as kernels.

name: Olive, fresh
definition: fresh uncured olive; cured table olives are J5.

name: Pea
definition: fresh or frozen green pea, in or out of the pod.

name: Edamame
definition: fresh or frozen green soya beans in the pod.

name: Sprouts and cut microgreens
definition: sprouts and cut microgreens sold to eat; the split between bean sprouts and microgreens is open.

name: Mixed vegetables
definition: final kind of the sub-family: a plain mix of vegetables from several crop groups, such as frozen mixed vegetables, in which no one kind is half or more of the weight.

name: Coriander [cilantro]
definition: fresh or frozen coriander leaf, sold in bunches or packs to flavour food.

name: Wakame
definition: fresh or frozen wakame seaweed; dried is J5.

name: Mixed fruit and vegetables
definition: final kind of J4: a mix of fruit and vegetables, such as a party tray, in which no one kind is half or more of the weight.
